video.title: How to Find a Side Hustle Where Customers Already Exist

summary: The Side Hustle Nation host revisits the idea of selling where customers already gather, covering online marketplaces, newer platforms, and offline locations. Examples include digital products, resale, teaching, rentals, physical services, and vending, with operators describing how they reached existing audiences. The strongest recurring advice is to research demand, choose a specific niche, and keep improving how products reach buyers. Many examples still require substantial human work, particularly for physical delivery and in-person selling.
